name: OTPs
summary: High-confidence verification codes from phone notifications on the glasses.
description: Watches notifications after explicit Android approval, extracts likely one-time codes, and shows timed alerts plus a ten-entry history through Rokid Nexus.
author: Zhilin

listing.descriptionMarkdown:
## About

See high-confidence verification codes from phone notifications without reaching for the phone. Timed alerts include a countdown and Close action; alerts without a timer remain until closed or replaced. Opening OTPs from the Nexus launcher shows the newest ten entries.

## Privacy

Notification access must be granted explicitly in Android. All notification text and extracted codes are processed locally, the plugin has no Internet permission, and only the newest ten entries are kept in private app storage.
